name: monad-browser
description: Headless, turnkey browser CLI for AI agents: compact AX snapshots with @refs, warm daemon, raw CDP. No Playwright.

scripts.build:native: cd native && for t in linux/amd64 linux/arm64 darwin/amd64 darwin/arm64; do CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=${t%/*} GOARCH=${t#*/} go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../bin/native/mb-${t%/*}-${t#*/} . || exit 1; done
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run build:native
